t: What Treatment Effectiveness Database Is All About
title: What Treatment Effectiveness Database Is All About
description: Treatment effectiveness asks what works, for whom, and how well: antibiotics cure strep throat in days (NNT ~4 for symptom relief), statins cut heart attack risk ~25% relatively (NNT ~100 over 5 years for primary prevention), and CBT matches medication for many depressions with fewer side effects. Numbers needed to treat (NNT) translate trial math into human terms. Reference information, not medical advice — treatments need clinicians. This database is the complete treatment comparison: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
